ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Primary white field with a dark, mottled band along the trailing edge. Right lobe: Distal white patch (coordinates distal 40%) and a large, mottled dark region extending from the notch towards the center-right.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees; vertical notch depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left trailing edge displays low-amplitude, low-frequency serrations. Right trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys, particularly near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges are convex. Trailing edges exhibit a sigmoidal sweep, beginning with a concave curve at the notch and transitioning to a convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of circular, high-contrast grey/white pixel groups at the distal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The right distal tip exhibits an irregular, eroded structural profile, indicating significant tissue loss or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated white pixel 'island' is visible within the dark pigmentation field of the right lobe near the median notch.
